## Description and Rationale

I completed my Bachelor's degree in Aeronautical Engineering at Istanbul Technical University (ITU), and I am currently working on foundational topics in Aerospace Engineering that underpin this challenge's subject area.

I am participating as a solo participant. My academic and research interests lie in the foundational methods underlying this challenge, particularly machine learning and data-driven modelling techniques, which I aim to apply to the prediction of taxi-out time and its operational variability.
